name: 16046 · Mars, PA
findings: ZIP 16046 (Mars) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16046 (Mars) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 16046 (Mars) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).
